nodes.summary: 1. The continuum hypothesis holds if and only if the continuum equals ℵ₁. 2. The continuum hypothesis holds if and only if the continuum is at most ℵ₁. 3. The continuum hypothesis holds if and only if the reals have cardinality ℵ₁, i.e. |ℝ| = ℵ₁. 4. The continuum hypothesis holds if and only if there is no cardinal strictly between ℵ₀ and the continuum. 5.
nodes.title: Equivalent forms of the continuum hypothesis
